description: [PAID $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Generate an original 1024x1024 image from a text prompt with FLUX.1 [schnell] on Workers AI (about 2-5 s). Returns JSON with image_base64 + mimeType, or the raw image bytes with format=jpeg. Content policy: no sexual/nude, gore, hate, real or famous people, or ID documents/currency; such prompts get HTTP 400 and are not charged. All params optional: with no prompt a sample watercolor lighthouse is drawn.

prompt.description: What to draw (max 1000 chars). Optional: defaults to a watercolor lighthouse.
